Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, and forgetting a stove that starts a fire is inadvertent negligence, not the intent or conscious disregard of an obvious fire risk that malice requires.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is defined as the alternation of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction and ejection), with no third named phase.

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds hold molecules in an open crystalline lattice, so pressure favors the denser liquid and gives the negative slope.
